title: Run a website in a container
summary: Start nginx in a container and open it in your browser.

tasks.title: A container called `hello-web` is running
tasks.hint: Give the container a name with `--name hello-web`, and keep it running in the background with `-d`. `docker ps` lists the running ones.

tasks.title: It runs the `nginx` image
tasks.hint: The image name goes last: `docker run -d --name hello-web nginx`.

tasks.title: `http://localhost:8080` shows the nginx welcome page
tasks.hint: nginx listens on port 80 inside the container. Open a door on your laptop with `-p 8080:80`. A container's ports can't be changed after it starts, so remove it first with `docker rm -f hello-web`, then run it again.
